checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the distinctive large, fleshy cheek pads (flanges) characteristic of a dominant male orangutan. The face structure appears broad and flat.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are visible, dark, and positioned for forward-facing vision. No anatomical anomalies detected in eye placement.

The visible upper torso exhibits the massive, barrel-chested build typical of great apes.
The rear of the animal is not visible in this framing, so the absence of a tail cannot be visually confirmed, though it is biologically expected.
